visual_action: The video is a split-screen. The top panel initially shows Vice President Kamala Harris speaking from a presiding chair. It then cuts to a wide shot of a legislative chamber where numerous people are standing and applauding. The bottom panel consistently shows a close-up of Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson, who smiles and appears emotional as she looks up.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Is shown in the top half of the screen at the beginning, speaking and presiding over the event.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: Is shown in the bottom half of the split screen throughout the video, reacting emotionally to her confirmation.

cast.name: U.S. Senate
cast.evidence: A large body of legislators are shown giving a standing ovation in what appears to be the Senate chamber.

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris is heard saying, "and this nomination is confirmed." This is followed by the sound of a large crowd applauding loudly.
audio_music: The audio consists only of a short spoken line followed by the diegetic sound of a large group of people giving a standing ovation. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video uses a simple split-screen format. There is one cut in the top panel from a close-up of Kamala Harris to a wide shot of the applauding chamber. The pacing is slow and focuses on the reaction.
central_claim: The confirmation of Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court, presided over by Vice President Kamala Harris, was a historic and celebrated moment.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel pride and celebrate the historic achievement of confirming the first Black woman to the U.S. Supreme Court.
